# Security Policy

Security fixes target the current `main` branch of Lobby.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please [report vulnerabilities privately](https://github.com/guesant/lobby/security/advisories/new).
Include the affected URL or component, reproduction steps, and the potential impact.
Do not publish vulnerability details in issues or pull requests before coordinated disclosure.

The [maintainer's shared security policy](https://github.com/guesant/.github/blob/dev/SECURITY.md)
provides additional guidance on sensitive information and responsible disclosure.
